_comment: Per-person photo decisions for npm run team:import. `file` = a unique piece of the photo file name BEFORE the " - " (e.g. "WA0064") — use it when the importer lists a photo as ambiguous. `focus` = where the 4:5 crop should be centred ({ "x": 0.5, "y": 0.35 }, fractions of the photo) when the automatic crop cuts a head. Keys are member ids from team.json.
